titulo: Relativas explicativas e redução: Revisão e prática da aula 46

aula.objetivo: Distinguir orações relativas que identificam das que apenas acrescentam informação (entre vírgulas), usar «which» para comentar a frase inteira, e reduzir relativas com -ing e particípio.

itens.audio: My brother, who lives in Rio, is a doctor
opcoes: My brother, who lives in Rio, is a doctor
My brother that lives in Rio is a doctor
My brother who lives in Rio is a doctor
itens.gabarito: My brother, who lives in Rio, is a doctor

itens.audio: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone
opcoes: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone
He passed the exam, what surprised everyone
He passed the exam that surprised everyone
itens.gabarito: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone

itens.audio: The man standing there is my uncle
itens.respostaEsperada: The man standing there is my uncle
itens.explicacao: Escreva: the man standing there is my uncle.

itens.audio: The book written by her is famous
itens.respostaEsperada: The book written by her is famous
itens.explicacao: Escreva: the book written by her is famous.

opcoes: My sister, who lives in Rio, is a nurse.
My sister who lives in Rio is a nurse.
My sister that lives in Rio is a nurse.
itens.gabarito: My sister, who lives in Rio, is a nurse.

itens.enunciado: Qual palavra comenta a frase toda?
Qual é a forma reduzida de «The man who is standing there»?

opcoes: Brazil, which is huge, has many cultures.
Brazil, that is huge, has many cultures.
Brazil which is huge has many cultures.
itens.gabarito: Brazil, which is huge, has many cultures.

itens.enunciado: My boss, ___ name is Tom, is kind.
The book ___ by her is famous. (escrito)
People ___ in cities use buses. (que moram)
Ordene: «My sister, who lives in Rio, is a nurse.»
itens.gabarito: My sister, who lives in Rio, is a nurse.

itens.enunciado: Ordene: «She is always late, which is annoying.»
itens.gabarito: She is always late, which is annoying.

itens.enunciado: Escreva 4 frases: uma explicativa, uma com «, which», uma reduzida com -ing e uma reduzida com particípio.
itens.respostaEsperada: My sister, who lives in Rio, is a nurse. He passed the exam, which surprised everyone. The man standing there is my uncle. The book written by her is famous.

blocos.enunciado: Fale 1 minuto sobre o seu país, usando relativas explicativas e comentários com «which».
Descreva a sua família com informação extra entre vírgulas.
